## What changed?

Describe the change in plain language.

## Why?

What problem does this solve or what capability does it add?

## How was it verified?

- [ ] Automated tests pass
- [ ] New behavior has tests where practical
- [ ] No secrets or credentials were added
- [ ] Documentation was updated if behavior changed

## Risk / compatibility

Describe any breaking changes, deployment impact, security implications, or known limitations.

## Screenshots / evidence

Add screenshots, logs, benchmarks, or example output when they help reviewers verify the change.
